# SC-GW
> SC-GW provides software development, consulting, and technical services, with a focus on web, cloud, and enterprise solutions.

SC-GW appears to be a company website presenting its services, capabilities, and contact information rather than a large documentation portal. The most useful pages for LLM context are the core company, services, and contact pages.

## Main
- [Home](https://sc-gw.com/): Overview of the company, its offerings, and primary navigation.
- [About](https://sc-gw.com/about/): Company background, mission, and general business information.
- [Services](https://sc-gw.com/services/): Summary of the technical and consulting services offered.
- [Contact](https://sc-gw.com/contact/): Contact details and inquiry options for prospective clients.

## Services
- [Software Development](https://sc-gw.com/services/): Custom software engineering and solution delivery information.
- [Web Solutions](https://sc-gw.com/services/): Website and web application development capabilities.
- [Cloud Services](https://sc-gw.com/services/): Cloud-oriented implementation and consulting offerings.
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://sc-gw.com/services/): Business and enterprise technology service overview.

## Company
- [About](https://sc-gw.com/about/): Company profile and organizational overview.
- [Home](https://sc-gw.com/): Entry point for understanding the company and its positioning.
- [Contact](https://sc-gw.com/contact/): Ways to reach the company for business discussions.

## Contact
